<strong>Que représente le journalisme de: What does dialogue journalism mean to you?
Ce n’est pas un concept qui m’a été ense: It’s not a concept that was taught to me during my journalism studies. Dialogue journalism is journalism that is able to listen, and is also able to give. There’s often a lack of listening on the part of the media, a distance from the public, and the exchange can even harm certain people.
Les couvertures médiatiques ont des cons: Media coverage has real consequences on the lives of some people, who are already more stigmatized and marginalized. Dialogue journalism is journalism that takes the time to listen to what the public has to say. It’s about creating content that respects the people we listen to.
